about: What A9 (evals/privacy/run.ts) accepts. Owner rules: learning is never counted, stored or shown, not even as anonymous totals (CORE-PRINCIPLES promise 2); 2026-11-16: no Ask records, no anonymous totals (monthly Ask run counts and retrieved-content traces must go). Every entry needs its reason. Owner and contributor authoring, and records a person chooses to share, are the only data-changing writes a staff request may reach.

ownerOrSystemEntries.app/api/consultant/: Owner API: owner session checked on every handler.
ownerOrSystemEntries.app/api/contribute/: Named contributors who sign in to author resources (not staff learning).
ownerOrSystemEntries.app/api/cron/: Scheduled job, not a staff request.
ownerOrSystemEntries.app/api/offline/: Owner settings for the offline edition.

writes.lib/content/page-copy.ts: Owner page-copy authoring (owner session checked in app/api/consultant/page-copy).
writes.lib/content/editable-surfaces.ts: Owner surface authoring (owner session checked in app/api/consultant/content).
writes.lib/content/page-text.ts: Owner page wording overrides (POST /api/page-text checks the owner session; staff GET only reads).
writes.lib/content/page-edits-store.ts: Owner page edits (POST /api/page-edits checks the owner session; staff GET only reads).
writes.lib/content/resource-drafts.ts: Owner resource drafts (staff pages only read the published copy).
writes.lib/content/contributor-resources.ts: Named contributor authoring behind the contributor session.
writes.lib/consultant-toolkit/cases.ts: Shared workspace cases a person chooses to save and share (P14; content they choose, encrypted). Needs the private-details reminder and a retention rule.
writes.lib/decision-records/store.ts: Decision records a team chooses to keep (chosen work, encrypted).
writes.lib/policy-analysis/store.ts: Policy analysis cases a person chooses to save (chosen work, encrypted).
writes.lib/sp-clone/request-store.ts: A request a person chooses to send (staff POST is closed today).

storedFunctions.consume_runtime_rate_limit: Short-lived rate-limit bucket keyed by an HMAC of the address; operational protection, not learning. Retention not verified by this eval.
storedFunctions.purge_expired_security_records: Deletes expired owner-session revocations and rate-limit buckets (housekeeping that removes data).

cookies.one_dsd_context: product context (One DHS or One DSD view)
